about.desktop.text:
Quarrel Ex v1.1.8
Battle City / Battle City Ex Editor

Web and Desktop share QuarrelExConfig v3, including stage maps, Enemy Type / Count / Total, Demo, Screen, and Runtime extensions.
Runtime 6.9.4 / QXR1 v6 supports independent Stage 1–70 P1/P2 spawns, Icons/Number enemy counters, packed per-stage rules, and no stage flash with GAME OVER Skip; Demo keeps original spawn/pacing/near-HQ behavior.
.nes ROMs can be opened by drag and drop, with an unsaved-changes prompt. Runtime 6.5 Final Rules, custom 1–8 enemy spawns, GAME OVER Skip, extra-life rules, 2P Win Streak, and armored-tank durability are retained.
about.line1: Web/Desktop continue to share QuarrelExConfig v3; stage maps, Enemy Type / Count / Total, Demo, Screen and Runtime extensions remain interoperable.\r\n
about.line2: Runtime 6.9.4 / QXR1 v6: independent P1/P2 spawns for Stage 1-70, Icons/Number enemy counter, packed per-stage rules, no stage flash with Skip ON; Demo preserves original spawn/pacing/near-HQ cease-fire behavior.\r\n
about.web.text:
Quarrel Ex Web v1.6.8

A local browser-based Battle City / Battle City Ex editor.
Supports drag-and-drop .nes opening, Undo/Redo, Save/Save As, QuarrelExConfig v3, per-stage import/export, and Runtime 6.9.4 / QXR1 v6 features including Stage 1–70 player/enemy spawns, EnemyPacing, BaseExists, Enemy Counter, Final Rules, and other Ex options.

Supports Original16K / Ex16K / Legacy 32KB Overlay / BCEX v2 32KB 70-map.
ROM data is processed locally in your browser.

rules.not_detected_web: QXR1 Final Rules / Runtime 6.5-6.9.4 were not detected.

rules.streak_note: Win Streak fixed rules: 1 win=1000, 2=2000, 3=4000, 4=6000, 5=8000, 6=10000, 7+=+1 life. A tie breaks the streak; when the winner changes, counting restarts from 1 win.
rules.summary.desktop: QXR1 v2-v6 Final Rules; Runtime 6.9.4 / v6 adds an independent Death Level. Cheat lives and enemy pacing require v3+. Skip defaults OFF; Win Streak rewards increase with consecutive wins and a tie breaks the streak.

rules.two_player.original: Original: +1000 to the player with more kills this stage
rules.two_player.streak: Win Streak: increasing reward for consecutive wins
screen.desktop_note: 1 cell = 1 NES 8×8 background CHR tile. The original BATTLE / CITY / GAME / OVER use a 32×32 magnified-glyph routine, so each blue box represents one complete source-glyph slot; click it to select a CHR tile. Only existing ROM screen strings are changed; coordinates, lengths and $FF terminators are preserved. Attr is preview-only and is not written to ROM.
screen.note: 1 cell = 1 NES 8×8 background CHR tile. BATTLE / CITY / GAME / OVER are drawn by the original game's 32×32 magnified-glyph routine, so each large blue box represents one complete source-glyph slot rather than four independently editable 8×8 cells. The editor only changes existing ROM string content; coordinates, length and $FF terminators are preserved. Preview Attr affects display only and is not written to ROM.
screen.pick_note: Click a blue box to select a tile
settings.custom_enemy.group_desktop: Stage 1-70 Custom Enemy Spawns (Runtime 6.5+ Final Rules)
settings.custom_enemy.note_desktop: 1P/2P can each select Original or 1-8. Both modes share S1-S8 coordinates but have independent Counts; safe center coordinates are fixed to $18-$D8.
settings.custom_spawn.demo: Demo does not use Stage 1-70 custom enemy spawns.
settings.custom_spawn.supported: 1P/2P can each choose Original or 1-8; S1-S8 coordinates are shared and Counts are independent. Safe centers are $18-$D8; orange indicates non-$0D terrain.
settings.custom_spawn.unsupported: QXR1 Final Rules were not detected; use a 32KB Runtime 6.5-6.9.4 IPS.
settings.custom_spawn.unsupported_web: QXR1 Final Rules were not detected; use an updated 32KB Runtime 6.5-6.9.4 IPS.
settings.death_level.note: A hit destroys the player at or below the Death Level; higher levels lose one level and survive. Death Lv4 makes every level die in one hit.
settings.death_level.unsupported: Independent Death Level requires Runtime 6.9.4 / QXR1 v6. Older runtimes continue to use the Downgrade on Hit option.
settings.global_spawn: Original Global Spawn Positions (drag tanks; coordinates and view stay synchronized)
settings.lock.supported: Lock only controls the respawn base level after death; Stars/Pistol still upgrade normally during the current life. Original global spawns remain draggable.
settings.lock.unsupported: This ROM does not support Lock Initial State; initial level, lives and original global spawn positions remain editable.
settings.lock_initial: Lock initial state: Stars/Pistol can still upgrade; after death, respawn returns to the configured initial level
settings.lock_initial.short: Lock Initial State (restore initial level after death; Stars can still upgrade)
settings.pacing.demo: Demo does not use Stage 1-70 independent enemy pacing.
settings.pacing.note: Each stage can independently configure 1P/2P spawn intervals and maximum simultaneous enemies. Lower intervals are faster.
settings.pacing.note_desktop: Configure 1P / 2P separately per stage. Interval is in frames; lower is faster. Max simultaneous enemies is 1-6. Original Stage 35 reference: 1P=50 frames, 2P=30 frames.
settings.pacing.reference: Original Stage 35 reference: 1P interval 50 frames, 2P interval 30 frames; original max active is 1P=4, 2P=6. Total counts for the four enemy types are still configured separately in Enemy Editor.
settings.pacing.restore: Restore Original Pacing for This Stage
settings.pacing.stage_status: Stage {0}: 1P {1} frames / max {2}; 2P {3} frames / max {4}. Smaller intervals are faster.
settings.pacing.unavailable_web: QXR1 v3 / Runtime 6.6 was not detected; the enemy pacing table cannot be edited.
settings.pacing.unsupported: QXR1 v3 / Runtime 6.6 was not detected; enemy pacing is not editable.
settings.player_spawn.demo: Demo does not use Stage 1-70 independent player spawns.
settings.player_spawn.requires: Per-stage P1/P2 player spawns require QXR1 v5 / Runtime 6.9.3.
settings.player_stage.note: Each stage can use Original/global or independent Custom positions for P1/P2.
settings.player_stage.note_desktop: P1 / P2 can independently use Original (global player spawn above) or Custom. Custom uses the $18-$D8 16px grid.
settings.player_stage.status: Stage {0}: P1 {1} ${2},${3} / terrain ${4}; P2 {5} ${6},${7} / terrain ${8}. Dragging either marker automatically switches it to Custom.
settings.spawn_note: Drag tanks to change positions, or enter X/Y directly below. P1/P2 use their player palettes; E1/E2/E3 use enemy tank CHR.
spawn.drag_note: Drag tanks to change coordinates; P1/P2 use their Sprite Palettes and enemies use enemy-tank CHR.
